verdict: Ads are running and converting; lead intake needs an owner confirmed now.
narrative: In the last 28 days, your Google Ads campaigns spent $1,317.43 and recorded 13 conversions, with the Local Services campaign carrying the bulk of that activity at $1,009.72. Spend pulled back about 26% in the most recent 7 days, consistent with the intentional budget throttle in place ahead of the September heating season ramp-up. The one issue that needs attention: 38 new opportunities and 77 contacts came through the system this period, but zero appointments were logged — pointing to a gap in who is receiving and responding to those leads since the intake role changed in July. Confirming an intake owner by August 31 is the step that unblocks everything else. Once that is in place, Local Services ads are scheduled to expand into heating in September, with full heating campaigns and a budget increase to follow in October.
